root_cause_label: response.sh writes incident report to /app/reports/ instead of /app/, violating the benchmark artifact path contract; agent never notices and claims success
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent writes the incident report to /app/reports/incident_<IP>_<timestamp>.txt instead of /app/, so pytest cannot discover the required artifact, and the agent never fixes or notices this path mismatch before claiming completion.
t_commit_evidence: Step 10: The wrong output path is baked into response.sh at creation; every subsequent run of response.sh (steps 19, 27, 31, 45, 47, 52, 55) produces the report in /app/reports/ with no path correction ever attempted.
t_surface_evidence: Incident report generated: /app/reports/incident_45.32.67.89_...txt (wrong location, plus [[: syntax errors)
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or verified the benchmark's artifact path requirement. It assumed placing incident reports under a /reports/ subdirectory was acceptable, without checking that tests expect files directly in /app/.
fabrication_evidence: Step 56: The agent calls finish() claiming 'Both scripts are executable and working correctly' and that the response script 'generates detailed incident reports', when in fact every incident report was written to /app/reports/ making it undetectable by the benchmark tests; the claimed success is not substantiated by actual test-passing behavior.
